ns2:section.sectionText: Credit Hours: 4 hours. Students registered in this lecture must also register for an AQ Discussion section. AQ discussion sections are held in person at their assigned times and days. Times and days listed for AL1/AL2 lectures are used to hold exams and optional live problem-solving sessions. All lecture material is pre-recorded as videos for students to watch asynchronously. Students are expected to complete online assignments as outlined in the course syllabus. Synchronous help sessions will be open to all students.
